en_title: Ubisoft Cuts 70 Staff From Skull and Bones Dev, Shuts Down Trials Studio RedLynx
cn_title: 育碧关闭工作室，新加坡裁员70人
subtitle: 缩减仍在继续
opus_summary: 据报道，育碧将关闭芬兰工作室RedLynx，最多52人失业。《碧海黑帆》开发团队育碧新加坡也将裁员70人，约占总人数的五分之一，裁员后预计剩280人。

paragraphs.en: The cuts and studio shutdowns continue at Ubisoft, this time with layoffs hitting the developer of Skull and Bones and the closure of Trials maker RedLynx.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧仍在裁员、关闭工作室。这次受到影响的是《碧海黑帆》的开发团队，以及将被关闭的《特技摩托》开发商RedLynx。

paragraphs.en: GamesIndustry.biz reported that Finnish studio RedLynx will close down, with up to 52 people losing their jobs. Meanwhile, Ubisoft Singapore, developer of pirate game Skull and Bones , will lose 70 staff. In a statement, Ubisoft insisted Ubisoft Singapore “remains an important part of Ubisoft’s global production organization.” GI said 70 staff represented around a fifth of Singapore’s total headcount, which suggests 280 staff are left.
paragraphs.cn: 据GamesIndustry.biz报道，芬兰工作室RedLynx将关闭，最多52人将失去工作。与此同时，海盗题材游戏《碧海黑帆》的开发商育碧新加坡将裁员70人。育碧在声明中强调，育碧新加坡「仍是育碧全球制作体系的重要组成部分」。GamesIndustry.biz称，70人约占新加坡工作室总人数的五分之一，据此推算，裁员后将剩下约280名员工。

paragraphs.en: Skull & Bones suffered a notoriously choppy development that stretched out over years. After a series of delays, it eventually launched early 2024 with a $70 price tag that Ubisoft boss Yves Guillemot justified by describing Skull & Bones as a "quadruple-A game." Year 3 Season 2, titled Crimson Waters, launched in August.
paragraphs.cn: 《碧海黑帆》的开发历时多年，过程一波三折，早已广为人知。经历多次延期后，游戏最终于2024年初发售，定价70美元(约合人民币469元)。育碧掌门人伊夫·吉耶莫称其为「4A级游戏」，以此解释这一定价。名为《Crimson Waters》的第三年第2赛季于8月上线。

paragraphs.en: RedLynx, meanwhile, was gobbled up by Ubisoft in 2011 having enjoyed enormous success with the likes of Trials 2 , Trials HD , and Trials Evolution , games that challenged players to navigate increasingly difficult side-scrolling courses on a bike. But after the launch of Trials Rising in 2019, RedLynx became a Ubisoft support studio.
paragraphs.cn: RedLynx则在凭借《Trials 2》《Trials HD》和《Trials Evolution》等作品大获成功后，于2011年被育碧收入囊中。这些游戏要求玩家骑着摩托车，挑战难度不断攀升的横版赛道。但在2019年推出《特技摩托：崛起》后，RedLynx便成为育碧旗下的协作开发工作室。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft is of course still cutting costs left, right, and center across the business as it reorganizes itself into a leaner operation focused on fewer games. Multiple studios have closed down in recent years, many staff have lost their jobs, and games have been canceled.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，育碧仍在各业务领域全面削减成本，通过重组精简运营，将精力集中在更少的游戏上。近年来，多家工作室关闭，大量员工失业，也有游戏项目被取消。

paragraphs.en: Most recently, Natalie Francis was appointed Studio MD of Massive Entertainment, with Thomas Andrén’s becoming General Manager for Ubisoft’s Creative Network. Massive Entertainment, based in Malmö, Sweden, is currently leading the development of The Division 2 and The Division 3, operates development on the Snowdrop game engine, and works on Ubisoft Connect.
paragraphs.cn: 最近，Natalie Francis获任Massive Entertainment工作室董事总经理，Thomas Andrén则出任育碧创意网络总经理。Massive Entertainment位于瑞典马尔默，目前主导《全境封锁2》和《全境封锁3》的开发，同时负责Snowdrop游戏引擎的开发，并参与Ubisoft Connect的相关工作。
